`v0.16.0` fixes Omarchy freezing when one Vulkan app closes and another starts, keeps `omarchy refresh pacman` and Omarchy channel switches working, gives every display its own pointer, and makes full screen and startup smoother.

# Features

* With more than one display, each window has its own pointer mapped to its own screen, wherever the screens are arranged and whatever their size, scale or rotation (#425, #424)
* Omarchy's window appears with its desktop already drawn. The loading window stays up until the wallpaper, the bar and the first frame are on screen (#412, #430)

# Fixes

* Fix the whole guest freezing when a Vulkan app such as vkcube or Zed closes and another one starts (#416, #407)
* Fix `omarchy refresh pacman`, Omarchy channel switches and reinstalling Omarchy's packages failing on a dependency error and leaving the package setup broken. Existing installs get the fixed commands on their next start, before Update > Omarchy, and an install a failed refresh already broke is put back (#411, #414, #408)
* Fix Ghostty showing no window on Intel graphics that offer OpenGL 4.2 (#417, #383)
* Fix Ghostty showing an empty window on AMD graphics (#405, #383)
* Fix red and blue showing swapped in Vulkan windows on Intel graphics (#404, #400)
* Fix the Omarchy window staying black for the whole session on some AMD graphics cards after the loading window lifts (#399, #358)
* Fix QEMU's empty window, or a second Try Omarchy taskbar button, showing for a moment while Omarchy starts (#415, #413, #419, #421, #430)
* Fix the window appearing at the wrong size after a display or taskbar change while Omarchy starts (#420)
* Fix full screen flickering black when the pointer moves, with the Windows taskbar showing over it (#422)
* Fix leaving full screen after a full screen start giving a window larger than the screen that could not be resized or landed in the corner (#422, #423, #429)
* Fix leaving full screen sometimes keeping the screen's size, and a maximized window coming back un-maximized (#428, #429)
* Fix Ctrl+Alt+F doing nothing on the first press right after the pointer comes back into the window, or in the second window with two displays (#427, #428)

## Dev

* Build runtime r28 with the BGRA swap, GLSL 4.30 storage buffer and Venus worker teardown fixes, and QEMU display windows that the launcher holds until their first frame (#404, #405, #416, #415, #423, #427, #428, #430)
* Refresh the guest package lock twice, which brings in kernel 7.3.4, Mesa 26.2.7, glibc 2.44 and PipeWire 1.6.11-2 (#418, #426)
* Follow stable Omarchy releases with a daily check that opens an upgrade PR and marks it ready once the full guest build and boot pass (#387)
